text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: quality regression detected for tenant 'acme-corp' in dedicated-pool eu-west-1. metric: eval_regression.customer_promptset -> delta -0.12 (12% drop). suspected cause: model/quantization profile rollout (redwood-3b-quant v2.6). paging: @Marta

Marta: @oncall-bot got it. looking. tagging eng-oncall and cs. @Elaine can you confirm whether acme-corp has opened a support ticket? :eyes:

Elaine: I see a support case opened at 08:14 UTC, customer reports multiple 'hallucinated' completions in their helpdesk pipeline. Adding logs/attachments to the ticket now. :zap:

Marta: tyler, can you take live? I need to triage isolation and rule out pool-level problems. acme is on a dedicated pool, but rollout targeted tenants with quant profile v2.6 last deploy 08:12UTC.

Tyler: on it. pulling model rollout timeline. looks like a config promotion pushed the new quant profile to a subset of tenants in eu-west-1. acme-corp got v2.6. checkpoint: perf/latency looks normal, but quality evals show drop.

Sanjay: quick check -- are we seeing increased model perplexity or token-level artifacts? I can run a local eval against acme's promptset. where's the promptset ID?

Elaine: promptset id cust-acme-help-2026-03-15 attached in support thread. customer included examples.

Tyler: running smoke eval now. command:
```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/v1/internal/eval/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_INTERNAL" \
  -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","promptset":"cust-acme-help-2026-03-15","model":"redwood-3b-quant:v2.6"}'
```
Expecting results in ~90s.

Ops-bot: NOTE: acme-corp route currently pinned to dedicated-pool eu-west-1 (pool-id: dp-eu-42). No other tenants show correlated regression signals.

Marta: good — isolation confirmed. immediate mitigation options: 1) revert quant profile for acme to v2.5, 2) route acme to model variant redwood-3b-nq (non-quant) temporarily, 3) rollback the global promotion (not acceptable if isolated). I recommend option 1 + smoke tests. Tyler, can you prepare a revert and a verification plan? I'll coordinate comms.

Tyler: preparing revert. planned steps:
- create emergency canary: update tenant profile -> quant_profile: v2.5 (previous).
- warm KV-cache if possible (prefetch common prefixes).
- run smoke evals (10k tokens) and sample checks.
- monitor eval_regression metric and customer-reported examples.
Command to patch tenant routing (internal API):
```
POST /internal/tenants/acme-corp/overrides
{
  "field": "quant_profile",
  "value": "v2.5",
  "reason": "emergency revert due to quality regression",
  "initiated_by": "Tyler"
}
```
I'll run now and report results.

Marta: please add temporary flag `mitigation_reason=quant_regression_revert` so auditing picks it up. also set TTL 1h for the override. Elaine, can you notify customer we're investigating and planning a rollback? be transparent about actions + ETA ~15-30m.

Elaine: notifying now. draft: "We're seeing a degradation in generated quality after a model quantization promotion; we're rolling your tenant back to the previous profile and will update once verified (estimated 20–30 minutes)." Sending.

Tyler: apply override now... PATCH returned 200. Ops-bot: route update applied for tenant acme-corp, quant_profile=v2.5, override_ttl=3600s.

Ops-bot: background jobs: warming KV-cache for acme-corp (prefetch key prefixes flagged in customer prompts).

Sanjay: smoke eval results (v2.5 after revert) vs v2.6 before revert:
- sample accuracy proxies: v2.6=0.68 -> v2.5=0.81
- BLEU-ish proxy on promptset: -12% -> baseline restored
- no increased latency.

Tyler: looks good. pushing a few live queries to confirm. initial live samples align with customer expectations.

Marta: confirm telemetry: eval_regression signal trending back to baseline in last 4m. Setting incident status -> mitigated.

Elaine: customer acked the update and said early samples look better. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Tyler: recording short timeline for post-incident: quant-profile v2.6 promoted at 08:12UTC -> regression detected 08:13UTC -> pager 08:14UTC -> revert 08:17UTC -> mitigated 08:21UTC.

Marta: nice work. immediate next actions:
- Send RCA thread and include rollback audit (Tyler)
- Run full A/B backtest across acme promptset with instrumentation (Sanjay)
- Block auto-promote for quant profiles until QA gates added (Marta + eng-runtime)
- Customer follow-up call scheduled by Elaine for 14:00 UTC today
Add owners and deadlines in postmortem doc.

Ops-bot: NOTE: incident closed (mitigated). Please create follow-up ticket in #postmortems and tag `quant-profile` and `dedicated-pool` labels.

Marta: handing off to Sanjay for deeper analysis. I'm going offline in 20m; paging for any regressions. Sanjay, ping me if you need escalation. :wave:
summary: Single-tenant quality regression after quant-profile rollout; immediate revert to previous profile restored quality for acme-corp. Actions: postmortem + GA/QA gate.
